leave_sick_family_003.evidence: Sick leave may be used for the following reasons only: • Employee illness • Illness in the employee’s immediate family

leave_personal_days_004.answer: 5 days state personal leave + 2 days local leave
leave_personal_days_004.evidence: State law entitles all employees to five days of paid state personal leave per year.

leave_personal_restrictions_005.answer: Requires written request and principal/supervisor approval; prohibited on state-mandated assessment days; supervisor considers substitute availability and program impact.
leave_personal_restrictions_005.evidence: An employee wishing to take discretionary leave shall submit a written request to his or her principal or supervisor... No employee shall be granted discretionary use of state personal leave on days scheduled for state-mandated assessments at his or her campus... availability of substitutes, will be considered by the principal or supervisor.
